name: PHSS710_Tonijn
description: The last of the four Dolfijn-class submarines, the first domestic submarines built for the Royal Netherlands Navy after World War II. Their hulls consisted of three separate pressure hulls, allowing them to dive deeper and with greater stability than previous submarines. The class formed the core of the Dutch submarine force during the Cold War. Tonijn herself was decommissioned in January 1991 and is now a museum ship.

consumables.name: Damage Control Party
consumables.description:
Extinguishes fires, removes instances of flooding, and repairs damaged modules.
Prevents enemy acoustic torpedoes from homing.

consumables.name: Hydrophone
consumables.description: Highlights the positions of ships and submarines on the surface or at periscope depth that are beyond spotting range. Ship positions are ascertained at the moment you activate the consumable.

consumables.name: Submarine Surveillance
consumables.description: Detects submarines at maximum and periscope depths.

consumables.description: Increases dive and ascent speed and reduces diving plane shift time.
